changes.title: DHS Secretary Mullin says thousands arrested in New York immigration operation
changes.summary: During a news conference in New York, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said the people arrested were "criminals" and slammed New York's governor and mayor for not working with ICE.

changes.title: No plans for ICE to be at polls for midterms, DHS says
changes.summary: A senior DHS official said ICE will do their regular duties on the day of midterm elections, though Sec. Markwayne Mullin said agents would enter a polling place to serve a warrant.

changes.title: What to know about Trump's claim that over 250K non-citizens are registered to vote
changes.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin sent letters to four states alleging that a combined 250,000 non-citizens were registered to vote. Elections experts caution that could be a significant overcount.
